title: UK Car Finance Compensation Scheme Paused After Legal Challenge, Delaying Payouts Until 2027 or Later
author: James O'Connor
image: /images/news/UK FCA Partially Suspends Motor Finance Redress Scheme, Delaying Billions in Compensation.webp
excerpt: The UK Financial Conduct Authority has partially suspended its £9.1 billion motor finance redress scheme after legal challenges, delaying compensation payments to millions of motorists until at least 2027.

title: Samsung Launches Galaxy Card With Barclays as Tech Giants Enter Deeper Into Financial Services
author: Finance Desk
image: /images/news/Samsung Launches Galaxy Card With Barclays as Tech Giants Enter Deeper Into Financial Services.webp
excerpt: Samsung has launched its first U.S. credit card with Barclays, integrating rewards and payments into Samsung Wallet as the company expands deeper into financial services.

title: Crypto.com Secures $400 Million Citadel Securities Investment at $20 Billion Valuation
author: Finance Desk
image: /images/news/Crypto.com Secures $400 Million Citadel Securities Investment at $20 Billion Valuation.webp
excerpt: Crypto.com has secured a $400 million strategic investment from Citadel Securities, valuing the cryptocurrency exchange at $20 billion as traditional finance expands into digital assets.

title: Andrew Bailey Pushes Back on Banking Deregulation as UK Finance Faces AI and Growth Challenges
author: Finance Desk
image: /images/news/Bank of England Governor Defends Financial Rules Against Deregulation Calls.webp
excerpt: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey has defended financial regulation, arguing that well-designed rules support economic growth while warning against broad deregulation of the UK's banking sector.

title: France Lowers 2026 GDP Forecast to 0.7% Amid Budget Uncertainty and Global Energy Shock
author: David Smith
image: /images/news/France Cuts 2026 Growth Forecast as Budget Delays and Iran Conflict Hit Economy.webp
excerpt: France has lowered its 2026 economic growth forecast to 0.7% as delayed budget measures, weaker economic activity, and the impact of the Iran conflict weigh on the country’s outlook.

title: Global Markets Recover Slightly as Oil Prices Ease but Tariff and AI Concerns Keep Investors Cautious
author: Sarah Wu
image: /images/news/Global Markets Recover Slightly as Oil Prices Ease but Tariff and AI Concerns Keep Investors Cautious.webp
excerpt: Global markets attempted to stabilize after a sharp sell-off as oil prices eased from recent highs. Investors remain focused on Trump tariffs, AI spending concerns and inflation risks.

title: Capital One Rejects Trump Debanking Claims, Says Account Closures Followed AML Investigation
author: Tech Desk
image: /images/news/Capital One Says Trump Organization Accounts Were Closed After Anti-Money Laundering Review.webp
excerpt: Capital One says it closed more than 300 Trump Organization accounts after an anti-money laundering review, rejecting claims that the decision was politically motivated.
